pl.Как правило — добровольное страхование ч: Zazwyczaj — dobrowolne ubezpieczenie w oddziale NFZ właściwym dla miejsca zamieszkania, składki opłacasz sam (poza posiadaczami Karty Polaka).

en.ABC студента — Uniwersytet DSW Ideis Wro: Student ABC — Uniwersytet DSW Ideis Wrocław
en.все порталы, логины и оргвопросы с сайта: all portals, logins and administrative matters from the university website
en.Главное: почти всё завязано на один логи: The main thing: almost everything is tied to a single login — dswNRALBUMU (your student ID number will arrive by e-mail together with access to USOSweb). The same login and password from USOSweb give you access to Moodle and Microsoft 365. The USOSweb login becomes available from 1 October. If you were already an Ideis student and are continuing your studies (e.g. moving on to the 2nd cycle) — your login details do not change.
en.Порталы, которые нужны с первого дня: Portals you need from day one
en.Вход — теми же данными, что и в USOSweb: Log in with the same credentials as for USOSweb
en.login.microsoftonline.comOutlook, Teams,: login.microsoftonline.comOutlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, SharePoint
en.Логин: dswNRALBUMU@student.dsw.edu.pl, п: Login: dswNRALBUMU@student.dsw.edu.pl, password — the same as for USOSweb
en.Аккаунты активируются со 2-й половины се: Accounts are activated in the second half of September

en.dsw.jobteaser.comстажировки и вакансии о: dsw.jobteaser.cominternships and job offers from the Biuro Karier
en.С 2026/2027 основной билет — mLegitymacj: From 2026/2027 the main ID is mLegitymacja in the mObywatel app. It is issued automatically to every student with a PESEL number; no separate application is needed.
Only on request or if you have no PESEL. Cost — 22 zł. The application is submitted at the Dziekanat.
en.Персональный номер счёта придёт на e-mai: Your personal account number will arrive by e-mail. The deadline for the first payment is 15 October 2026, regardless of the payment plan chosen. In the transfer details give: first name, last name + "opłata za X ratę czesnego".
en.Оформляется по письменному заявлению в D: Issued on written request at the Dział Obsługi Finansowej Studenta (room 107a).
en.Страхует работодатель — университет и се: Your employer insures you — neither the university nor your family can register you.
en.До 26 лет, без своей страховки: Under 26, with no insurance of your own
en.Можно быть застрахованным как член семьи: You can be insured as a family member (parents, spouse, in some cases — grandparents).
en.Нужно подать заявление на страхование че: You need to apply for insurance through the university: kadry@ideis.pl.
en.Как правило — добровольное страхование ч: As a rule — voluntary insurance through the NFZ branch for your place of residence; you pay the contributions yourself (except holders of the Karta Polaka).
en.Ректора, для людей с инвалидностью, соци: Rector's, for people with disabilities, social, one-time financial aid (zapomoga).
en.Уточнять в Dziale Obsługi Finansowej Stu: Check with the Dział Obsługi Finansowej Studenta.
en.Вводная неделя знакомства с уни: тематич: An introductory week to get to know the university: themed workshops (criminology, psychology, media design, yoga, wendo for girls), board games, film screenings, an outdoor party. Follow the announcements on the website and social media.
en.С 27 апреля 2026 заявления на временный/: From 27 April 2026, applications for a temporary/permanent residence permit and EU long-term resident status are submitted online only via MOS. You need a profil zaufany or an electronic signature; old MOS accounts do not work.
en.В заявлении указывать e-mail уни: mos.wr: In the application give the university e-mail: mos.wroclaw@ideis.pl — otherwise the university will not be able to send and sign the required attachment to the application.
en.С 27.04.2026 бумажные заявления по основ: From 27.04.2026 paper applications for the main types of residence permit are no longer accepted — submission goes through MOS.
en.вт–чт 10:00–14:00, вс 9:00–14:00, сб 9:0: Tue–Thu 10:00–14:00, Sun 9:00–14:00, Sat 9:00–14:00, Mon and Fri — closed

en.Бесплатная у здания на Strzegomskiej 47: Free, by the building at Strzegomska 47 — call the number on the barrier
en.💡 Если что-то не работает с логином в US: 💡 If something does not work with your USOSweb/Moodle/MS365 login — contact helpdesk@dsw.edu.pl first, not Google: these are internal university systems and there are no ready-made solutions online.
